about: Shared test vectors for the cue model (cues.js / CuePlan and CueTracker), pinned from the JavaScript package (trailphysics on npm) and read by the Swift package (trailphysics-swift) from a byte-identical copy. Master: test/fixtures/cues.json in the JavaScript package, written by test/build-cue-fixtures.mjs from test/cue-routes.json. Each case is a route API cue list and segments, metres along the line and heights per vertex, and the plan for its sport; each trace replays fixes [metres along, m/s] (null: none) over a case's plan and lists the events as [fix index, type, cue index], with the tracker's state after the last fix.

traces.name: a stop, a gap and a way back
